_comment: Controlled vocabularies. Closed lists. If a value does not fit, add it here in the same commit as the record that needs it, with a one-line description. Never invent a value inline.

product_class.network.vpn_gateway: Remote access VPN concentrator or SSL VPN portal
product_class.network.load_balancer: Load balancer or application delivery controller
product_class.network.remote_access: Remote desktop or remote access gateway
product_class.security.edr: Endpoint detection and response agent or console
product_class.security.siem: SIEM, log platform or analytics console
product_class.identity.directory: Directory service such as Active Directory
product_class.identity.sso: Identity provider or single sign-on service
product_class.app.collaboration: Chat, conferencing or document collaboration platform
product_class.app.itsm: IT service management or ticketing platform
product_class.app.office_suite: Office productivity suite and the document formats it opens
product_class.security.offensive_tool: Penetration testing or red team framework, whether licensed, cracked or public
product_class.cloud.iaas: Infrastructure as a service administrative API and console
product_class.cloud.identity: Cloud identity or tenant administrative API and console
product_class.ot.ics: Industrial control system, where the source was no more specific than that
product_class.ot.plc: Programmable logic controller or remote terminal unit
product_class.ot.safety_system: Safety instrumented system or safety controller
product_class.ot.hmi: Human machine interface or operator station
product_class.ot.engineering_workstation: Engineering workstation, or the configuration and programming software running on it
product_class.ot.scada_server: SCADA server, control server or front end processor
product_class.ot.protection_relay: Protective relay or intelligent electronic device
product_class.ot.protocol_gateway: Protocol converter, serial to Ethernet gateway or data diode
product_class.app.licensing: Software licence server or licence manager service that other software depends on to run
product_class.app.mdm: Mobile device management, enterprise mobility management or unified endpoint management console, and the enrolment channel it pushes configuration profiles and applications through
product_class.facility.physical_access: Badge, door and physical access control system
product_class.app.version_control: Source hosting, file sharing or collaboration service usable as an egress path
product_class.facility.surveillance: IP camera, video surveillance or physical monitoring system
product_class.app.middleware: Message broker, queue or integration middleware
product_class.app.msp: Managed service provider platform or tooling with customer access
product_class.process.service_desk: Service desk, help desk and the identity verification process behind account recovery
product_class.cross_sector: Not a product; used where the record is about an organisation type or process rather than a technology
product_class.app.ai_platform: Model registry, inference platform, agent runtime or the gateway in front of one
product_class.telecom.ran: Radio access network: base stations, gNB, O-RAN components and the air interface
product_class.telecom.core: Mobile core network functions, control plane and user plane
product_class.telecom.signalling: Inter-operator signalling and roaming interconnect, including SS7, Diameter and GTP
product_class.telecom.subscriber: Subscriber equipment and identity: UE, SIM and subscriber databases

role.victim: The technology itself was exploited, compromised or targeted
role.inline_tool: The technology was used by the attacker to carry out the activity, whether abused legitimately or as installed tooling
role.telemetry_source: The technology was how the activity got observed, not what got hit
role.lateral_path: The technology was traversed or trusted on the way to the real target
role.control_bypassed: The technology was a control the attacker evaded or disabled
role.mentioned: Named in the source for context only, with no observed activity

impact.persistence: Survives reboot, upgrade or credential reset
impact.lateral_movement: Used to reach further into the estate
impact.dos: Denial of service, crash or reboot loop
impact.defence_evasion: Logging, alerting or security control interfered with
impact.loss_of_view: Operators lost visibility of the process
impact.loss_of_control: Operators lost the ability to command the process
impact.process_manipulation: The physical process was altered or was positioned to be altered
impact.safety_function_compromise: A safety instrumented function was disabled, altered or put at risk
impact.reconnaissance: Information gathering with no further observed action
impact.pre_positioning: Access established and held with no observed objective beyond keeping it
impact.ip_theft: Intellectual property, trade secrets or design data taken

attack_surface.internet_facing_management: Management interface reachable from the internet
attack_surface.internet_facing_service: The service the product exists to offer, reachable from the internet
attack_surface.vpn_portal: SSL VPN or remote access portal
attack_surface.local_network: Reachable only from inside the network
attack_surface.remote_access_service: Remote access provisioned for operations or maintenance, whether VPN, jump host or a remote desktop tool
attack_surface.it_ot_boundary: The crossing point between the business network and the control network
attack_surface.third_party_access: Integrator, vendor or contractor connection into the environment
attack_surface.watering_hole: A compromised site the target was expected to visit
attack_surface.insider: A person with legitimate access acting outside their remit, or in error

evidence_type.http_proxy: Web proxy or web access logs
evidence_type.web_server: Web server access or error logs
evidence_type.netflow: Flow records or firewall session logs
evidence_type.tls_metadata: TLS handshake metadata, certificates, JA3 or JARM
evidence_type.file_artefact: Files found on disk during response
evidence_type.email_gateway: Mail gateway or message trace logs
evidence_type.integrity_check: Vendor integrity checker or file verification tool
evidence_type.ics_protocol: Industrial protocol traffic, parsed or as flow records
evidence_type.asset_inventory: Asset or device inventory state and the changes to it
evidence_type.process_telemetry: Process values, alarms and operator actions from the control system itself

fidelity.alert: Specific enough to raise an issue on its own
fidelity.hunt: Needs an analyst to judge; too broad to alert on
fidelity.enrich: Context only; adds meaning to something else

actor_type.unattributed: The source named no actor or declined to attribute

source_type.vendor_advisory: The affected vendor's own security advisory
source_type.government_advisory: National CERT, agency or joint advisory
source_type.vendor_research: Security vendor research or threat intelligence blog
source_type.independent_research: Independent researcher, unaffiliated with a vendor
source_type.academic_research: Peer-reviewed paper or preprint; describes a class of attack or measures tooling, rather than reporting one intrusion
source_type.database: Aggregator such as NVD or KEV
source_type.licensed_intel: Licensed or internal intelligence; handled as restricted and never attributed to its source

target_sector.energy.electric: Electricity generation, transmission and distribution, including renewables
target_sector.energy.oil_gas: Oil, gas and petrochemical production, processing and transport
target_sector.water: Water and wastewater treatment and distribution
target_sector.manufacturing: Discrete and process manufacturing, including automotive
target_sector.transportation: Rail, road, aviation, maritime and ports
target_sector.defence: Defence, defence industrial base and aerospace
target_sector.cross_sector: Reported across sectors, or not sector specific

marker_type.process_path: Full or partial path to an executable
marker_type.command_line: Process command line or argument substring
marker_type.parent_process: Parent image name for a parent/child test
marker_type.scheduled_task_name: Scheduled task, cron or timer name
marker_type.registry_value_name: Registry value name under a key
marker_type.domain: Fully qualified domain or DNS suffix
marker_type.http_header: HTTP header name or value shape
marker_type.ip: IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR
marker_type.group_name: Group, role or login class name
marker_type.cloud_operation: Cloud or SaaS audit operation name
marker_type.computed: A derived condition requiring computation rather than a field lookup; expr is mandatory
marker_type.event_type: Normalised event type or operation sub-type
marker_type.event_outcome: Success, failure or other outcome value
marker_type.zone: Network zone or segment name on either side of the session

rule_shape.single_event: One event matching the markers is enough; a filter
rule_shape.correlation: Two or more different event types must be joined
rule_shape.threshold: A count, rate or distinct-count must exceed a bound
rule_shape.sequence: Events must occur in a given order within a window
rule_shape.absence: The signal is an expected event not arriving
rule_shape.inventory: Answered against asset or configuration state, not an event stream

locus.CONTROL: The subject's own decisioning: routing, signalling, session establishment, forwarding, orchestration and scheduling, policy and trust evaluation
locus.MANAGEMENT: Administration of the subject: admin access, configuration change, admin credentials, console, SSH, SNMP, API and firmware, and a cloud provider's administrative API whatever that provider calls it
locus.DATA: What traverses or is held: user traffic, payload, files, mail, business data
locus.ENDPOINT: Execution on a host, being process, file, registry and memory, where the subject is an operating system or agent with no plane decomposition
locus.SUPPLY: Build, update, dependency, vendor and integrator paths
locus.ORGANISATION: Posture, process, people and trust relationships; the finding is an inventory or advice question rather than an event located on a device
